'''Guard Squadron''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]]-equipped squadron of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] active during [[3637 BBY]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]] during the [[Revanite crisis]] the squadron was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] coalition along with Republic forces under [[Satele Shan]]. Guard Squadron Walkers guarded the encampments established by the Empire in the area between the [[Coalition Command Post]] and the [[Temple of Sacrifice]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Guard Squadron Walkers appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion as Champion Guard units for the Imperial camps on Yavin 4.
